episodes.title: Piggy
episodes.summary: Piggy finds something that proves useful to the group but is hurt when his new friend breaks a promise.

episodes.title: Jack
episodes.summary: Jack's determination to kill a pig leads him to neglect other duties, with grave consequences.

episodes.title: Simon
episodes.summary: Simon tries to warn his friends as the latest beast sighting spreads terror across the camps.

episodes.title: Ralph
episodes.summary: Ralph jumps into action when violence escalates, then realises with horror that it is his turn to be hunted.
